$comment: Stack manifest for aw-deploy (>= 0.3.0). One component per compose file; a component's services version in lockstep (one CI build tags all its images identically). A component is managed on a box iff a .env exists next to its compose file. tuyere-writing-receiver is deliberately absent: it pins an 'edge' tag outside the release-tag discipline and is managed via 'aw-deploy compose'.
